chunks: Lest a soul should say: 'Alas, I was heedless of God and only laughed;'

key_terms.جَنْبِ اللَّهِ: Side of God / In the cause of God
key_terms.فَرَّطْتُ: I was negligent / I fell short

ai.seo_question: What does the soul regret saying on the Day of Judgment regarding its past behavior?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Az-Zumar is often cited to illustrate the profound regret of the 'sakhirun' (those who mocked or treated faith lightly) on the Day of Judgment, emphasizing that their frivolity was a form of negligence against divine command. It underscores the transition from worldly amusement to eternal sorrow, serving as a warning for believers to maintain seriousness in their worship and adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings.
